resolution.note: Operator approved D30 amendment: exact-head full Jenkins gate required, local isolation gate optional. Local-gate CPU reservation no longer required.

title: Give the local gate reserved CPU and admit it by CPU pressure
body:
Outcome: until krn/gate-local is retired, gate:local runs in its own systemd user slice with a high CPUWeight (verify the user manager delegates the cpu controller first), and krn deliver admits the gate by CPU pressure (/proc/pressure/cpu some avg60 below a stated bound) instead of the 1-minute load average <= 6 (src/deliver/cli.ts:75, src/deliver/delivery.ts loadavg); host-lock still serializes gate runs.
Operator 2026-11-02: "3. ogarnij lepiej" (the lead proposed a reserved slice plus pressure-based admission).
Evidence: 2026-11-02 10:33 on krn-desktop (16 cores): load average 7.7-12.5 from unrelated sessions, CPU 19.6% idle, PSI cpu some avg60 5.2%; PR #163 deliver timed out at the load gate after 30 min. Timing tests went red at load 29 (memory host-concurrency-cap); related flake tasks t-4ct3j6q, t-rq6sw2v, t-xevd1d8, t-ymbw0jb.
Proof: deliver admission unit test with injected PSI and loadavg readings (high load, low pressure admits; high pressure waits; unreadable PSI falls back fail-closed); gate-local starts its runner under the slice (receiver test against systemd-run or a verbatim capture).
